prompt.title: AI Prompt
prompt.reviewPrompt: Review or edit the AI prompt before generating names
prompt.editHint: You can edit this prompt to customize how the AI generates names. Changes will be used for this generation only.

config.briefSubtitle: Fill out the brief or import from a file
config.industryTooltip: Specify your business sector or market niche. This helps the AI understand your target audience and generate contextually appropriate brand names.
config.keywordsTooltip: Enter words or concepts that should inspire the brand name. These can be values (trust, innovation), attributes (fast, eco-friendly), or related terms (cloud, spark). The AI will use these to generate relevant name ideas.
config.toneTooltip: Select the personality and feel of your brand name. You can choose multiple tones to blend different characteristics, or add a custom tone.
config.charLengthTooltip: Choose preferred name lengths by character count. Short names are punchy, long names allow more detail.
config.wordCountTooltip: Choose how many words should be in the brand name. Single words are memorable, multiple words offer more meaning.
config.languageTooltip: Select the language for generated names. 'Both' will create a mix of English and Russian name suggestions.
config.customInstructionsPlaceholder: Any additional requirements for name generation...
config.customInstructionsTooltip: Add any specific requirements not covered above. E.g., 'avoid names starting with X', 'include nature themes', or 'must work as a domain name'.
config.targetAudiencePlaceholder: e.g., Tech-savvy millennials, Parents with young children...
config.targetAudienceTooltip: Describe your ideal customers: age group, gender, interests, lifestyle, values. This helps generate names that resonate with your audience.
config.positioningPlaceholder: e.g., Premium yet accessible, Disruptive innovator, Trusted expert...
config.positioningTooltip: How do you want your brand to be perceived? What makes you different from competitors? Define your unique position in the market.
config.competitorsPlaceholder: Enter competitor names separated by commas
config.competitorsTooltip: List your main competitors. AI will generate names that differentiate you while staying relevant to your industry.
config.inspirationBrandsPlaceholder: Enter brand names you admire, separated by commas
config.inspirationBrandsTooltip: List brands (from any industry) whose names you admire. This helps establish the style and feel you're aiming for.
config.restrictionsPlaceholder: e.g., Avoid religious terms, no names starting with 'X', must not sound similar to...
config.restrictionsTooltip: Specify what to avoid: certain letters, sounds, meanings, cultural associations, or anything else that's off-limits.
config.geographicMarketPlaceholder: e.g., Global, North America, Europe, Asia...
config.geographicMarketTooltip: Where will your brand operate? This affects pronunciation, cultural appropriateness, and domain availability considerations.
config.mktuClassesHint: Select trademark classes for your industry
config.mktuTooltip: Nice Classification (MKTU) defines product/service categories for trademark registration. Select classes relevant to your business for accurate trademark checking.
config.advancedOptionsDesc: Fine-tune character length, word count, creativity, and more
config.creativityTooltip: Controls how experimental the AI gets. Low = safer, more conventional names. High = more unique and unexpected suggestions.

creativityLevels.lowDesc: Less random. The most direct name ideas
